root_cause_label: Agent incorrectly assumed TensorFlow was needed and then fell back to a manual protobuf reconstruction approach with wrong weight encoding assumptions (float32 instead of LC0 default LINEAR16), exhausting all steps without producing a valid PyTorch model
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wasted the first 19 steps repeatedly trying to install TensorFlow and tf2onnx (none of which the task requires), then committed to a manual protobuf reconstruction approach using incorrect float32 decoding instead of LC0's default LINEAR16 encoding, and hit Python interpreter mismatches at the end, consuming all 60 steps without ever saving a valid PyTorch state dict.
t_err_evidence: Step 6: agent executed `import tensorflow as tf` in an IPython cell, revealing the false premise that TF was needed to parse the LC0 network file; this wrong assumption drove repeated TF install attempts through step 19.
t_commit_evidence: Step 22: agent wrote a local net.proto file and subsequently installed protoc and compiled it (steps 23-26), committing fully to manual proto reconstruction; the rest of the trajectory (steps 27-60) was spent on this incorrect path with wrong weight decoding assumptions, making recovery impossible.
t_surface_evidence: Step 29: first execution of `parse_weights.py` failed with AttributeError (NoneType has no attribute 'shape'), indicating that the manual parsing approach was producing incorrect results.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of LC0's custom protobuf format: (1) it did not know that the network file can be parsed with standard protobuf using the official proto schema without TensorFlow; (2) it did not know that LC0's LayerAdapter defaults to LINEAR16 encoding when no encoding is specified (encoding=0/UNKNOWN), causing all float decoding attempts to treat data as float32 and fail with buffer size errors or produce garbage values; (3) it did not know about the lc0 leela2onnx tool for direct conversion.
forewarning_evidence: Step 9: TF install failed (version not found). Steps 12-13: TF install timed out and was aborted. Steps 15-16: repeated TF install attempts failed or timed out. These repeated failures before step 22 (t_commit) were clear signals that the TF approach was unworkable.
